Linked list reversal
Reverse links in a singly linked list in place.
Next node එක save කරලා current node එJකේ next link එක prev Jවත හරවන්න. අවසානJයේ prev අලුත් head එක.
Before 1 2 3 null · After 3 2 1 null · Each arrow is a next pointer. After reversal the head changes to node 3. Input එJකන් result එක දකේවා state Jවනස් Jවන ආකාරය බලන්න.
Complexity / cost: O(n) time; O(1) extra
Interview Q & A: Why save next first? Rewiring would lose the rest of the list.
Memory trick: 3→2→1 → null — trace the example before coding.
Practice: Test null, single node and three nodes (acyclic lists).
